title: 第9章 杀手书生第10章 两袖清风
content_zh:
那种癖好，有人能理解就怪了。
沈二觉得他离得实在太近了，别开脸，“你如此不辞辛苦地刨坟，未来的医学宗师非你莫属。”
“不单是这个。”他被沈二的话绕回去，又道：“还有…”
话还没说完，他的身子轰然倒下，好在沈二及时扶了一把，不然他整个人都得栽进火堆里。
看着他靠在树上安静的睡颜，这么看，沈二感觉他也没那么邪乎了，活脱脱一个俊俏少年郎。
跟她一样也是没娘的可怜人，既答应了跟他称兄道弟，结伴而行，后面就试试能不能把他拉回正道。
刨人家坟刨一路，这个事实在太缺德了。
等等，沈二脑子里灵光一闪。
称兄道弟。
她低头看了眼自己。
“……”
夜～??）?
安衍揉着后颈睁开眼，入眼的夜幕让他有些恍惚。目光一扫，沈二抱膝坐在远处，背对着他，背影尽显落寞。
觉察到他的视线，沈二回头看他，一副生无可恋的模样。
这让安衍有些摸不着头脑，“你怎么了？”
看他那副样子，沈二知道他肯定全忘了，她叹了口气，摇摇头，“既然你醒了，那就继续赶路吧。”
耽搁半天，得连夜把路程进度赶上。
安衍疑惑，想去探知她在想什么，被沈二敏锐察觉，并用意念弹开。
“我已经今时不同往日了。”沈二得意洋洋，不料下一刻就咳嗽连连，狠狠打了她自己的脸。
安衍看了眼她背后，衣裳是昨日的，上面大片血污已经干涸发暗，“你要不先换身衣服？”

沈二摆摆手，“等到个正经的落脚地再说吧。”这荒郊野岭的换衣服也不方便，她现在特想泡个热水澡。
但谁能想到，这前不着村后不着店，鸟不拉屎的鬼地方竟然会有家驿站。
“还真是想什么来什么。”
驿站孤零零地立在大道旁，门前挂着两盏昏黄灯笼，内里灯火通明。
推开门，大堂内零零散散坐着几桌客人，有气质儒雅的书生，还有带着行囊的赶路人，一眼望去，一切正常。
沈二目光在那个书生身上顿了顿，书生边在灯下看书，边拿着折扇一扇一扇的，扇面上还写着什么什么风四个字。
许是看得太过直白，书生有所察觉，沈二随即收回视线。
一背过身，便感觉背后有好几双眼睛在盯着自己。
“两位？”柜台后探出一张圆脸，是个四十来岁的妇人，笑得和气，“打尖还是住店？”
“住店。”安衍答道：“来两间上房。”
“住店的话，只剩一间上房了。”妇人视线在二人身上打转：“二位……”
“一间就一间。”沈二不等她说完就拍了板，“同住一间房，方便照顾我家少爷。”
安衍站在她身后，闻言挑了挑眉，没说话。单看二人的衣着打扮，说是主仆确实说得过去。
妇人又看了他俩一眼，喜笑颜开：“行嘞，公子您随我来，带您去房间。”
“舒服——”
沈二泡在浴桶里，烟雾缭绕，脑袋惬意地后仰，枕在桶壁，简直不要太爽。
content_en:
It's weird that someone can understand that kind of quirk.
Shen Er felt that he was too close, so he turned away and said, "You have worked so hard to dig your grave. You must be the future medical master."
"It's not just this." He was distracted by Shen Er's words and said again: "There is also..."
Before he finished speaking, his body collapsed. Fortunately, Shen Er helped him in time, otherwise he would have fallen into the fire.
Looking at his peaceful sleeping face leaning against the tree, Shen Er felt that he was not so evil anymore, he just looked like a handsome young man.
Like her, she is a poor motherless person. Since she agreed to be his brother-in-law and go together, she will try to see if she can bring him back to the right path.
The fact that you are digging into other people's graves is so immoral.
Wait, an idea flashed in Shen Er's mind.
call each other brothers.
She glanced down at herself.
"..."
Night~??)?
An Yan rubbed the back of his neck and opened his eyes. The night that entered his eyes made him feel a little dazed. With a glance, Shen Er was sitting far away with his knees in his arms, his back turned to him, his back showing loneliness.
Aware of his gaze, Shen Er turned back to look at him, with a look of despair.
This made An Yan a little confused, "What's wrong with you?"
Seeing his look, Shen Er knew that he must have forgotten everything. She sighed and shook her head, "Since you're awake, let's continue on our way."
After a long delay, I had to catch up on the journey overnight.
An Yan was confused and wanted to find out what she was thinking, but Shen Er was keenly aware of it and bounced it away with his mind.
"I am no longer the same as before." Shen Er was proud of herself, but unexpectedly, she coughed repeatedly and hit herself hard in the face.
An Yan glanced behind her. The clothes were from yesterday, and the large blood stains on them had dried and turned dark. "Why don't you change clothes first?"
Shen Er waved his hand, "Let's wait until we find a serious place to stay." It was not convenient to change clothes in this wilderness, and she really wanted to take a hot bath now.
But who would have thought that there would be an inn in this ghostly place with no village or store.
"You really get whatever you want."
The inn stood alone beside the avenue, with two dim lanterns hanging in front of the door and brightly lit inside.
Opening the door, there were several tables of guests scattered in the lobby, including elegant scholars and passers-by with luggage. At a glance, everything seemed normal.
Shen Er's eyes paused on the scholar. The scholar was reading under the lamp while holding a folding fan one by one. There was also the word "wind" written on the fan.
Perhaps the scholar was looking too directly, and Shen Er noticed it, and Shen Er immediately looked away.
As soon as he turned around, he felt that there were several pairs of eyes staring at him from behind.
"You two?" A round face popped out from behind the counter. She was a woman in her forties. She smiled kindly. "Are you going to be a top or stay in a hotel?"
"Stay in the hotel." An Yan replied, "Come and have two rooms."
"If we want to stay in the hotel, there is only one room left." The woman's eyes wandered over the two of them: "You two..."
"Just one room." Shen Er didn't wait for her to finish speaking before he made the decision, "Living in the same room makes it easier to take care of my young master."
Anyan stood behind her and raised his eyebrows when he heard this, but said nothing. Just looking at the clothes of the two of them, it is indeed reasonable to say that they are master and servant.
The woman looked at them again and smiled happily: "Okay, sir, come with me and take you to the room."
"Comfortable——"
Shen Er was soaking in the bathtub, filled with smoke. He leaned his head back comfortably and rested his head on the wall of the tub. It was simply not very pleasant.
